payload.blocks: Closing plan 261124-0004 phase 7, and through it the land-door changelog step and the next admissions in the owner's sequence.
payload.headline: Heads-operate phase 7 asks for planner and shaper probes, but no planner or shaper head is live

parts.cause: A planner or shaper head can start only on a discussion; starting one just to run a read-only probe would also start its real planning or shaping work.

options.cost: None now; one probe run later.
options.does: Phase 7 closes on lead, supervisor and secretary probes; planner and shaper are probed the next time one starts for real work.
options.gain: Phase 7 and the plan close today; the sequence moves on.
options.harm: Planner and shaper permission rows stay unproven live until then.
options.label: Accept three personas

options.cost: About 20 minutes and two head sessions.
options.does: Supervisor starts one planner and one shaper on an existing settled discussion only to run the probe, then stops them.
options.harm: A started planner may begin writing a plan before it is stopped.
options.label: Start a throwaway head

parts.recommendation: Accept three personas: the rows for planner and shaper come from the same permission table already proven for three personas.

scope.allows: Closing phase 7 without planner and shaper probes in this plan only.
scope.forbids: Skipping the planner and shaper probe the next time those heads start.

parts.what: Phase 7's pass criterion wants the head-grant probe with no failed row in all five personas. Lead and supervisor are probed (no real failure), secretary is asked of Miu. No planner or shaper head is live.
